fields.title: Avengers: Infinity War
fields.synopsis: The Avengers and their allies must be willing to sacrifice all in an attempt to defeat the powerful Thanos before his blitz of devastation and ruin puts an end to the universe.
fields.cast: Robert Downey Jr., Chris Hemsworth, Mark Ruffalo, Chris Evans, Scarlett Johansson, Benedict Cumberbatch, Josh Brolin

fields.title: Interstellar
fields.synopsis: When Earth becomes uninhabitable in the future, a farmer and ex-NASA pilot, Joseph Cooper, is tasked to pilot a spacecraft, along with a team of researchers, to find a new planet for humans.
fields.cast: Matthew McConaughey, Anne Hathaway, Jessica Chastain, Michael Caine, Matt Damon

fields.title: Inception
fields.synopsis: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O., but his tragic past may doom the project.
fields.cast: Leonardo DiCaprio, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Elliot Page, Tom Hardy, Ken Watanabe, Cillian Murphy

fields.title: The Dark Knight
fields.synopsis: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological and physical tests of his ability to fight injustice.
fields.cast: Christian Bale, Heath Ledger, Aaron Eckhart, Michael Caine, Maggie Gyllenhaal, Gary Oldman, Morgan Freeman

fields.title: Baahubali: The Beginning
fields.synopsis: In the kingdom of Mahishmati, a fierce warrior rises from obscurity to uncover his royal heritage and avenge the murder of his father, the legendary Amarendra Baahubali.
fields.cast: Prabhas, Rana Daggubati, Anushka Shetty, Tamannaah Bhatia, Ramya Krishna, Sathyaraj

fields.title: RRR
fields.synopsis: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, who once were friends, join forces to chart a new path against oppressive British rulers in 1920s India.
fields.cast: N. T. Rama Rao Jr., Ram Charan, Ajay Devgn, Alia Bhatt, Shriya Saran, Samuthirakani

fields.title: Pushpa: The Rise
fields.synopsis: Pushpa Raj, a coolie, rises through the ranks of a red sandalwood smuggling syndicate in the Seshachalam hills of Andhra Pradesh, locking horns with relentless police officer Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat.
fields.cast: Allu Arjun, Fahadh Faasil, Rashmika Mandanna, Jagadeesh Prathap Bandari, Sunil

fields.title: Kalki 2898 AD
fields.synopsis: Set in a post-apocalyptic world in the year 2898 AD, a modern-day avatar of Vishnu descends to protect the world from evil forces in the sacred city of Kasi.
fields.cast: Prabhas, Amitabh Bachchan, Kamal Haasan, Deepika Padukone, Disha Patani

fields.title: Hi Nanna
fields.synopsis: A single father Viraj and his 6-year-old daughter Mahi, who suffers from cystic fibrosis, meet a kind-hearted woman Yashna who becomes an inseparable part of their lives, holding secrets to their past.
fields.cast: Nani, Mrunal Thakur, Baby Kiara Khanna, Jayaram, Priyadarshi Pulikonda

fields.title: Dangal
fields.synopsis: Former wrestler Mahavir Singh Phogat trains his young daughters Geeta and Babita to become world-class wrestlers, overcoming immense social stigma to win India's first gold medal at the Commonwealth Games.
fields.cast: Aamir Khan, Sakshi Tanwar, Fatima Sana Shaikh, Sanya Malhotra, Zaira Wasim, Suhani Bhatnagar
